description: This file defines the ResetBudgetJob class with methods to reset budgets for keys, users, teams, and end-users in a system, including updating database records and logging the process.

classes.name: ResetBudgetJob
classes.description: A class responsible for resetting budgets for keys, users, teams, and end-users, including database updates and logging.

methods.name: reset_budget
methods.description: Resets budgets for keys, users, teams, and end-user budget tables.

methods.name: reset_budget_for_litellm_team_members
methods.description: Resets the budget for all team members with expired budgets.

methods.name: reset_budget_for_litellm_budget_table
methods.description: Resets budgets for end-users and associated team members if expired, updating reset times.

methods.name: reset_budget_for_litellm_keys
methods.description: Resets the budget for all keys, handling exceptions and logging.

methods.name: reset_budget_for_litellm_users
methods.description: Resets the budget for all internal users, with exception handling and logging.

methods.name: reset_budget_for_litellm_teams
methods.description: Resets the budget for all internal teams, with exception handling and logging.

methods.name: _reset_budget_common
methods.description: Shared logic to reset spend and set reset time for a team, user, or key.

methods.name: _reset_budget_reset_at_date
methods.description: Calculates and sets the reset date for a budget based on its duration.
